blocks.text: About Jared Gibbons – South Surrey Realtor
Top 1% Fraser Valley REALTOR® at Royal LePage Little Oak Realty

parts.t: #1 at Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, 2025 and 2026 year-to-date.
Jared Gibbons

is a Top 1% Fraser Valley Realtor® and award-winning South Surrey real estate specialist serving South Surrey, Langley, White Rock, Surrey, Brookswood, Cloverdale, Ladner, Tsawwassen, and communities across the Fraser Valley.

A REALTOR® since 2015 with more than $500M in career real estate sales, Jared has built a reputation for delivering consistent, high-level results across residential, rural, and investment properties including condos, townhomes, detached homes, acreages, farms, land, and mobile homes.
Ranked among the top REALTORS® in the Fraser Valley, Jared’s recent achievements include:

items.t: • #1 Agent at Royal LePage Little Oak Realty
• Top 1% of all REALTORS® – Fraser Valley
• Top 10 Individual Dollar Volume – Fraser Valley

parts.t: Having lived in South Surrey for years and previously in Downtown Vancouver’s Yaletown for two years, Jared brings firsthand experience in both suburban family communities and urban condo markets. This unique perspective allows him to confidently guide clients relocating between city living and the Fraser Valley lifestyle — whether upsizing to a detached home, downsizing, or investing.

Now based in Brookswood, Langley, Jared offers deep local insight into neighbourhood trends, zoning changes, land use plans, development opportunities, and property values — giving his clients a competitive edge when buying or selling.

Raised on a Langley farm, he also brings specialized expertise in farm and acreage properties, with an understanding of the unique considerations of agricultural land, rural investments, and estate homes. His background makes him a trusted advisor for both lifestyle buyers and long-term investors.

Known for clear communication, strong negotiation skills, and data-driven marketing strategies, Jared provides hands-on guidance from first showing to final completion. He is especially passionate about helping first-time buyers, families upgrading, and investors capitalize on high-growth opportunities throughout the Fraser Valley.
If you’re looking for a trusted South Surrey & Langley Realtor® with proven results, local knowledge, and a Top 1% track record, Jared Gibbons delivers.
